fact: The Primature reports that AGEFAU's revised 2026 programme, adopted on 23 July 2026, includes extending network coverage and deploying Centres d'Acces Universel, Cases Wifi and Cases Numeriques to democratise internet access.
AGEFAU says its revised 2026 budget of FCFA 27.89bn retains network coverage extension in 162 localities of Mali, 80 Centres d'Acces Universel and 100 Cases Wifi.
